title: That's Not the Ocean in a Seashell
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: That's not the ocean in a seashell.
It's the noise of the room around you.
The hollow shell makes some pitches ring louder, like blowing across a bottle.
In a noisy cafe, the waves get louder.
In a very quiet room, the ocean fades to a faint hush.
An empty cup does it too.
